newsitem.title: ITALY: RUGBY UNION-TREVISO PART WITH WESTERN SAMOA'S KELLETT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TREVISO PART WITH WESTERN SAMOA'S KELLETT.

text.p: Italy's Benetton Treviso rugby club said on Tuesday they had parted with Western Samoan fly-half Darren Kellett for the current season because of his fitness problems.
A statement said the club had made the decision reluctantly but needed to act before a December transfer deadline.

"The decision was taken because the player has still not regained a suitable level of fitness because of the various ailments that have afflicted him and which continue to limit his performances," the statement said.

"Given that the deadline for replacing the foreign player is in December, the club wants to prevent any risk of finding itself after that date with a player who does not appear able in the near future to give what the club and fans expect."
Kellett was a leading player at last year's World Cup and joined Benetton Treviso in August.
